1.explanation:
We’ve created a new React component `ProgressBar` because Carbon doesn’t ship a percent-complete bar out of the box. The component takes `value`/`max` to compute percent, optional `infoAbove`/`infoBelow` for lines of context, and renders:
• A track (light gray background) with rounded corners
• A fill div (green bar) whose width is set to the computed percentage
• A percentage label positioned inside the track at the right
• Above/below text blocks for time remaining, speed, or current step

SCSS reuses Carbon color tokens (`$interactive-01`, `$ui-03`, `$text-02`) and global prefix to stay consistent with theming. The example usage shows the desired UX matching the screenshot.
1.bug_scenario: The Cloud Pak for Data installer needs a horizontal progress bar (not a step indicator) showing percent-complete status (1%) as a colored filled region inside a track. Above the bar appears an estimated time/speed line (“2 min remaining, 206 Mb/s”), and below it a current sub-step line (“Checking CPU on host 9.76.63.174”). The right end of the bar shows the numeric percentage.
